option_relations.rationale: There is no direct clinical relationship between Tumors of the follicular infundibulum and Eccrine poroma with glycogen accumulation.
Clear cell hidradenoma is a distinct adnexal tumor and does not have a direct clinical relationship with Eccrine poroma with glycogen accumulation.
Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma is a type of skin cancer and is not directly related to Eccrine poroma with glycogen accumulation.
Trichoepithelioma is a benign adnexal tumor of follicular differentiation and is not directly related to Eccrine poroma with glycogen accumulation.
